original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹琼莱州启动基层磋商以化解Twic East与Duk冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹琼莱州Twic East与Duk两县社区领袖正开展基层磋商，以缓解近期再度爆发的暴力冲突。代理州长Moses Majok Gatluak于10月4日分别任命两个12人代表团参与调解。该冲突自2023年以来持续，近期再次发生冲突。

location.raw_text: Jonglei State, Twic East and Duk counties

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹琼莱州启动基层磋商以缓解Twic East与Duk两县社区冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Grassroots consultations are underway in Jonglei State as community leaders from Twic East and Duk counties seek to ease tensions following renewed violence between the two communities.

key_facts.fact: 代理州长Moses Majok Gatluak于10月4日分别任命两个12人代表团
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The initiative was launched by caretaker Jonglei Governor Moses Majok Gatluak, who appointed separate 12-member delegations from the two counties on Oct. 4

key_facts.fact: 冲突涉及Twic East的Ayual社区与Duk的Hol社区，自2023年以来持续
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The conflict involves the Ayual community of Twic East and the Hol community of Duk and has persisted since 2023, with renewed clashes reported in recent weeks.

key_facts.fact: 代理州长表示警力与资金不足可能影响州政府工作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Majok said limited security personnel and funding could hamper the state government’s efforts.

uncertainties: 冲突伤亡情况未在报道中提及
和平磋商能否取得成果尚不确定
报道为单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），缺乏交叉验证
